library: geotruth exact engine with deliberate faults (mutant)
options: MUTATIONS (the point of this adapter): the 1st, 18th, 35th, ... reported predicate (counted over the whole run in field order) is negated; the 1st, 18th, ... non-empty polygonal overlay output has the second vertex of its first ring moved perpendicular to its neighbours' chord by max(1/256 of the ring's extent, 2^-20 of its largest ordinate), beyond every library's delta

exact answers through the shim of geotruth.harness.engine: geotruth.relate / geotruth.overlay when they exist, else the witness relate and the fallback overlay of tests/reference/indep.py (GEOTRUTH_EXACT_BACKEND selects)

overlay output: the non-strict exact result, every coordinate correctly rounded to a double; where rounding breaks validity the rounded rings are regularized exactly and rounded again (geotruth.harness.regularize.round_valid)
relate, predicates and overlay are 'unsupported' for invalid input and null where the engine abstains
